name: file-token-flip
argv: set -u; S=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/evidence/round-42/c2/fixtures/v2-be--squashfs_v2.0_be.bin; T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-flip.XXXX); for spec in orig:0:0 flag36_42:36:42 flags36_00:36:00 c20_01:20:01 c20_00:20:00; do n=${spec%%:*}; rest=${spec#*:}; off=${rest%%:*}; val=${rest#*:}; cp "$S" "$T/$n.bin"; if [ "$n" != orig ]; then printf "\\x$val" | dd of="$T/$n.bin" bs=1 seek=$off conv=notrunc status=none; fi; printf "%-11s byte20=0x%02x " "$n" "$(od -An -tu1 -j20 -N1 "$T/$n.bin" | tr -d " ")"; file -b "$T/$n.bin" | sed "s/Squashfs filesystem, //"; done; rm -rf "$T"
argv_shell: bash -c 'set -u; S=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/evidence/round-42/c2/fixtures/v2-be--squashfs_v2.0_be.bin; T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-flip.XXXX); for spec in orig:0:0 flag36_42:36:42 flags36_00:36:00 c20_01:20:01 c20_00:20:00; do n=${spec%%:*}; rest=${spec#*:}; off=${rest%%:*}; val=${rest#*:}; cp "$S" "$T/$n.bin"; if [ "$n" != orig ]; then printf "\\x$val" | dd of="$T/$n.bin" bs=1 seek=$off conv=notrunc status=none; fi; printf "%-11s byte20=0x%02x " "$n" "$(od -An -tu1 -j20 -N1 "$T/$n.bin" | tr -d " ")"; file -b "$T/$n.bin" | sed "s/Squashfs filesystem, //"; done; rm -rf "$T"'
note: controlled flip of candidate bytes in copies of v2be shows file(1)'s compressed/uncompressed token is driven by byte 20 (legacy inode_table_start_2 low byte, the v4 compression slot), not by the legacy flags word at byte 36
